name: 100day-of-learning-DA
description: Content database for the 100-Day Data Analyst Business Trainer. GitHub is the authoritative source for published learning, coding-arena, and dataset resources.

release_control.unlock_rule: A day becomes available only when its curriculum resource is published and the previous day is completed locally.
release_control.note: Days 4-100 are intentionally locked until their content resources are published.

content_contract: 1 JSON resource per learning day and 1 JSON resource per coding-arena day.

versioning.policy: Content changes are committed to GitHub and identified by the manifest version.
